div.head: VIIa Atr 8
div.ab: ⁊ æghwilce geare heonon forð gelæste man Godes gerihta huru rihtlice, wið ðam þe us God ælmihtig gemiltsige ⁊ us geunne, þæt we ure fynd ofercuman motan.
⁊ æghwilce geare heonon forð gelæste man Godes gerihta huru rihtlice, wið ðam þe us God ælmihtig gemiltsige ⁊ us geunne þæt we ure fynd ofercuman motan.
And æghwilce geare heonon forð gelæste man Godes gerihta huru rihtlice, wið ðam þe us God ælmihtig gemiltsige and us geunne, þæt we ure fynd ofercuman motan. God ure helpe. Amen.
And every year henceforth the most scrupulous care shall be taken in the payment of God's dues, in order that God Almighty may have mercy upon us and grant us victory over our enemies.
And every year henceforth, Church dues are to be paid with special conscientiousness, so that the almighty God will have mercy on us and enable us to overcome our enemies. May God help us. Amen.
And every year henceforth God’s dues are to be paid at any rate correctly, to the end that Almighty God may have mercy on us and grant that we may overcome our enemies.
Und in jedem Jahre künftig hin leiste man Kirchengerechtsame wenigstens genau, damit uns Gott der Allmächtige gnädig sei und uns gönne, dass wir unsere Feinde überwinden dürfen.
And every year henceforth let God's dues at least be paid correctly, so that Almighty God may have mercy on us and grant that we may overcome our enemies.
